baseline: Researcher completes a structured protocol template without the skill.
failure_condition: No improvement over the template on a sealed set, or any unsupported claim that a proposed experiment was performed.
intervention: A skill drafts variables, controls, measurement, falsifier, assumptions, and the cheapest discriminating next test.
primary_outcome: Share of independently reviewed plans meeting every preregistered actionability criterion.

baseline: Researcher uses ordinary search and a citation checklist.
failure_condition: Invented citations, concealed uncertainty, or no improvement over search on sealed cases.
intervention: A skill distinguishes support, contradiction, insufficient evidence, and outdated evidence using versioned, licensed primary sources.
primary_outcome: Blinded accuracy of the four-way decision and citation characterization.

baseline: Researcher follows an existing reproduction checklist.
failure_condition: Unauthorized execution or no reduction in verification time.
intervention: A skill ranks data, environment, code, and reported-result discrepancies for authorized local checks.
primary_outcome: Time to a researcher-verified first cause on a held-out reproduction package.
